name: libpg_query
license_evidence: LICENSE in the pinned release-tag archive (BSD 3-clause text); bundled PostgreSQL sources under the PostgreSQL License
input_api: pg_query_parse(local NUL-terminated SQL text) -> PgQueryParseResult (JSON parse tree)
scope: One SQL statement from local bytes; valid SELECT-with-join and multi-row INSERT controls, each equal to the hand-written oracle summary read from the library's JSON parse tree. PL/pgSQL, deparse, fingerprint and protobuf outputs are untested.
family: PostgreSQL grammar (libpg_query extraction of the PostgreSQL server parser)
family_note: pg_query_parse runs the extracted PostgreSQL raw parser (bison gram.c, flex scan.c, parser.c) and serializes the raw parse tree as JSON (pg_query_outfuncs_json.c). The adapter reads SelectStmt, InsertStmt, RangeVar, JoinExpr, FuncCall and A_Const nodes from that tree. Shared family: Go pg_query_go, Rust pg_query, Python pglast and the libpg-query/@pgsql WASM npm packages bind this library; DuckDB's parser is a libpg_query-derived fork.

popularity.metric: Debian popcon sourcemax installations, source package libpg-query
popularity.limitation: Very small count; packaged installs only, not use through bindings or vendored copies.
